description: Signal for one Hyperliquid perp, for trading bots. Everything on the signal board for the coin (price changes, funding, open interest, liquidations with their z-score, whale net position and tilt, flags) plus the 15-minute liquidation cascade probability from our forecast model, the nearest liquidation cluster above and below price from the 24 h liquidation heatmap, and the top 3 whale positions (side, size, entry, liquidation price). BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE or any other Hyperliquid perp. Poll every 1-5 minutes. An unknown coin answers 400 with the supported list and a stale source answers 503; neither is billed. Costs 0.004 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
